    • Improved display of settings and their descriptions
    • New display menu with switchable grouping of categories
    • Sorting by activation status, setting name, category and recommendation level possible
    • Saving the window position
    • Fixed problems with resizing the main window
  • Windows System Information Extended
  • Minor bug fixes
  • Available in German, English, French, Italian and Russian

elements.title: 1.5.1390 – Posted on 5/9/2017
elements.contents:
1.5.1390 – Posted on 5/9/2017 —

  • Available in German, English, French, Italian and Russian

elements.title: 1.5.1389 – Posted on 4/11/2017
elements.contents:
1.5.1389 – Posted on 4/11/2017 —
  • Enhancements and customizations for Windows 10 Creators Update 1703 (Build 15063)
  • New settings:
    • App launch tracking
    • How to control access to email for apps
    • App access control to contacts
    • Controlling app access to tasks
    • Access control for apps to call history
    • Controlling app access to notifications
    • Enhancements to Feedback & Diagnostics Settings
    • Let apps run in the background
    • Deactivate advertising via Bluetooth
  • Improve portability
    • Settings are no longer stored in the registry, but in an INI file
    • This is automatically created in the start directory of the program
    • It is unique for multiple users and across computer boundaries
  • The following bugs have been fixed:
    • Fixed disabling driver update
    • Factory settings have been revised
  • Available in German, English, French, Italian and Russian
    • Missing translations of the new settings in French, Italian and Russian will follow soon

elements.title: 1.4.1388 – Posted on 3/21/2017
elements.contents:

elements.title: 1.4.1387 – Published on 03/07/2017
elements.contents:
1.4.1387 – Published on 03/07/2017 —
  • The following settings have been changed:
    • Removed the “Don’t show recent users on the lock screen” setting as some users were experiencing issues accessing the system
    • Removed the “Hide logged-in user’s identifier on the lock screen” setting because some users were having trouble accessing the system
  • The following bugs have been fixed:
    • Dialog boxes in high contrast mode were buggy
    • Crash when clicking on links when Google Chrome was set as the default browser
    • Problems with the detection of some Windows 10 OEM versions
    • Note that some settings were managed by the organization did not disappear after factory reset
    • Factory settings have been revised
  • Available in German, English, French, Italian and Russian

elements.title: 1.4.1386 – published on 12/12/2016
elements.contents:
1.4.1386 – published on 12/12/2016 —

        – Disable tips, tricks and suggestions when using Windows
        – Disable occasional app suggestions in the Start menu

        – Restore point is only created when changes are to be made

  • Available in German, English, French, Italian and Russian

elements.title: 1.4.1385 – Published on 11/16/2016
elements.contents:
1.4.1385 – Published on 11/16/2016 —

        – Disable websites from saving protected media licenses on my device
        – Disable SmartScreen Filter
        – Disable page prediction
        – Disable user tracking on the web
        – Turn off search and site suggestions

  • Downgrading the following settings to “critical” because some users had problems logging in to the Windows system due to the activation of the settings

elements.title: 1.4.1383 – Published on 8/16/2016
elements.contents:
1.4.1383 – Published on 8/16/2016 —

  • High contrast mode is supported
  • Minor bug fixes

elements.title: 1.3.1359 – published on 8/10/2016
elements.contents:
1.3.1359 – published on 8/10/2016 —
  • Consideration of Windows 10 Anniversary Update (Version 1607 Redstone 1)
        – Wi-Fi Sense is no longer offered, so disabling this feature is obsolete
        – Various group policies have been changed in their validity, but this has not yet affected O&O ShutUp10
        – Cortana can no longer be disabled via Windows Settings; but with O&O ShutUp10 as before ;-)
  • Disabling OneDrive is no longer conditionally recommended, but not recommended
        – Some users use OneDrive for data backup and will no longer have access to the features offered by disabling them
        – To avoid accidental disabling, we have set the recommendation level to “not recommended”
  • Tooltips explain the importance of the pictograms for the recommendation level
  • The Windows 10 version (Threshold 1, Threshold 2 and Redstone 1) is now also displayed on the info page to make it easier to communicate with our support
  • Minor bug fixes

elements.title: 1.3.1358 – published on 6/14/2016
elements.contents:
1.3.1358 – published on 6/14/2016 —
  • The command line option “/quiet” was not correctly taken into account during import
  • New /nosrp option prevents recovery point (SRP) creation
        – This applies to import via command line, especially in combination with “/quiet”
        – The option also applies to the normal launch of the application, so no more SRPs are created
  • Minor bug fixes

elements.title: 1.3.1357 – Posted on 5/30/2016
elements.contents:
1.3.1357 – Posted on 5/30/2016 —

elements.title: 1.3.1356 – Posted on 3/10/2016
elements.contents:
1.3.1356 – Posted on 3/10/2016 —
  • Postponing upgrades no longer defers security updates
  • Advanced exception handling integrated:
        – When starting O&O ShutUp10 under the German Windows 10 Insider Build 14279, the German version of O&O ShutUp10 crashes.
        – This crash is also understandable in other applications that do not originate from us.
        – Workaround: Start OOSU10.EXE from the command line with the parameter “/lang:en” to load the English version.
  • Minor bug fixes
